name: What is the process for designing and building a retaining wall with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building a retaining wall with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for retaining walls begins with an initial consultation to understand your needs and site specifics. We then move to design planning, which can include CAD-supported layouts to visualize the wall's placement and integration with your landscape. This phase also covers material selection and permit coordination, critical for ensuring compliance in areas like Fort Worth. Once the design is finalized and permits secured, our experienced team manages the construction, installation, and final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination. This managed process ensures seamless execution and a structurally sound, aesthetically pleasing result.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group's process involves consultation, CAD-supported design, material selection, permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination.
